text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, insulin human is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Current inventory provides 16.7 to 27.7 days of supply across three sites. An ongoing Class II recall (D-0806-2026) for Baxter Healthcare Corporation's insulin human in 0.9% sodium chloride injection was initiated 2026-08-06 for CGMP deviations.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows insulin human is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The Baxter plant (FEI 1416980) was classified OAI on 2026-04-02 per inspection 1311078. FDA issued a warning letter to that plant on 2026-09-29.

Our position: Supply is adequate today but the Baxter recall and regulatory actions create risk. Eli Lilly and Company is not on FDA's shortage list and is the rule-recommended alternative source.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase agreement with Eli Lilly and Company; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer establishes reorder points and safety stock targets for the new supplier; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer monitors FDA shortage list and recall status weekly; no additional approval required.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or product substitutions at this time.
